summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing a press release dated September 14, 2026, regarding a second ballistic missile strike in five weeks on its Ukrainian subsidiary ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih, striking ironmaking complex #1. Two contractors were killed and two employees injured. Primary steel production is halted, other facilities idled or at minimum levels, with damage assessment ongoing and no repair timeline provided. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated. Not a special situation; watch for operational and earnings impact from Kryvyi Rih disruption.
